answer: Let a pearl of five randomly drawn graders decide each answer, with each grader staking POA on the verdict and a horizon appeal open to any dissenter: a quorum of four out of five must agree before the score seals, and a prism of public grade records makes self-grading visible at once. A garden of clones cannot grade itself into profit because the draw is public, the stake is slashed on a failed appeal, and the appeal itself is re-read by a fresh quorum.
